data.body: **P2 — Forward the runner through the review-address continuation.** Inline `/ai address` handling spans an intake run and a separate `workflow_run` continuation. The checked-in continuation and its documented caller template invoke `ai-pr-review-address.yml` without `runs-on`, so configuring this input on the primary caller still leaves the privileged continuation jobs on `ubuntu-latest`. Update the continuation caller example/template to pass its own runner label and add a regression check for this lifecycle.
